europe_now.title: US Envoys Push Ukraine Peace Talks Following Moscow Visit
europe_now.summary: United States presidential envoys have travelled to Ukraine to continue diplomatic efforts following substantive discussions with Russian leadership in Moscow. The meetings coincide with an announced short-term pause in active hostilities and ongoing international negotiations regarding the conflict.

Observers and local analysts are closely monitoring the voting outcomes for signs of broader shifts in national voter sentiment.
